findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div#iscrim.iscrim → linear-gradient(90deg, color(srgb 0.0784314 0.0784314 0.0784314 / 0.97) 28%, color(srgb 0.0784314 0.0784314 0.
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.
Give every clip a poster frame: in the study of 100 Sites of the Day only 31% had one, and the blank or grey boxes before the clips played were recorded as faults (references/imagery.md §11).

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (something lies over it).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Your library. Every screen." (screen 1, 100% over a picture); "Every screen." (screen 1, 100% over a picture); "Your films sit in folders." (screen 2, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 5 screens in a row: "Four apps, one library"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: 2 text block(s) sit within 12px of the screen edge: "A player in your browser" (0px from the right); "Watch anything on the server f" (0px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–20px). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.
